## Problem and resulting behavior

Describe the concrete problem and what changes for the user.

## Validation

List the checks performed and any failures, skips or acceptance still needed.
For IDE changes, distinguish automated tests from installed-plugin testing.

## Documentation and compatibility

Describe relevant updates to contracts, language/AI references, tutorials,
examples and plugin What's New. Explain migration, generated API or module
compatibility effects, or state why these do not apply.

For persistent state changes, identify the old states, versioned schema/data upgrade
steps, direct-upgrade behavior without intermediate app starts, failure/retry recovery
and automated baseline assertions. Follow the [mandatory upgrade policy](../docs/development/upgrade-policy.md).

See [CONTRIBUTING.md](../CONTRIBUTING.md) for contributor and maintainer guides.
